Players Committee card image of [[Captain Bewil (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While at a Cloud City site, adds one to the number of Bespin locations required to cancel Dark Deal. Once per turn, if Dark Deal on table, may search your Force Pile and take one Interrupt into hand; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainbewil.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
